title: Fibrates Inhibit PLTP-induced M2 Macrophage Infiltration and Increase the Sensitivity of Hepatocellular Carcinoma to ICIs.
authors: Liang, Xinyue; Li, Yaning; Cai, Jianxun; Luo, Lisi; Yang, Pengfei; Chen, Yutong; Zhou, Jiancong; Zeng, Yan; Yu, Jiaping; Zhang, Weiyu; Pang, Wenzheng; Li, Yufang; Wen, Chunhua; Li, Jian; Zeng, Linjuan
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦肝癌中PLTP通过AURKA/NF-kB通路促进M2巨噬细胞极化并影响免疫治疗，虽含分子对接但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作与肿瘤免疫，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: High levels of M2 macrophages in the hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) tumor microenvironment (TME) are associated with poor response to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). This study comprehensively investigated the role of phospholipid transfer protein (PLTP) in driving M2 macrophage polarization through bioinformatics, clinicopathological analysis, molecular docking, proteomics, biochemical and cellular assays. Additionally, strategies to enhance ICIs sensitivity are validated in multiple animal models. Results demonstrated that high M2 macrophage infiltration independently predicted inferior ICIs outcomes, and PLTP overexpression in HCC promoted M2 macrophage polarization. Mechanistically, PLTP bound to aurora kinase A (AURKA) and P65, forming a complex that induced P65 phosphorylation, thereby activating NF-kappaB and upregulating IL-6, IL-8, and CSF-1. Molecular docking revealed that GMB-475 specifically bound to PLTP's functional domain (25-245 AA), which competitively inhibited PLTP-P65-AURKA interactions and suppressing P65 phosphorylation. In vivo, GMB-475 reduced M2 macrophage infiltration and suppressed tumor growth. Fibrates downregulated PLTP expression, decreased P65 phosphorylation, and synergized with ICIs in orthotopic and Myc-driven HCC models. These findings highlight PLTP as a key mediator of M2 macrophage polarization via AURKA-dependent NF-kappaB activation. Targeting PLTP with inhibitor GMB-475 or fibrates may improve ICIs efficacy, offering a promising therapeutic strategy for HCC.
abstract_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）肿瘤微环境（TME）中高水平的M2巨噬细胞与免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）的不良反应相关。本研究通过生物信息学、临床病理分析、分子对接、蛋白质组学、生物化学和细胞实验，全面探讨了磷脂转移蛋白（PLTP）在驱动M2巨噬细胞极化中的作用。此外，在多种动物模型中验证了增强ICIs敏感性的策略。结果表明，高M2巨噬细胞浸润独立预测了较差的ICIs结局，且HCC中PLTP过表达促进了M2巨噬细胞极化。机制上，PLTP与极光激酶A（AURKA）和P65结合，形成复合物诱导P65磷酸化，从而激活NF-kappaB并上调IL-6、IL-8和CSF-1。分子对接显示，GMB-475特异性结合PLTP的功能域（25-245 AA），竞争性抑制PLTP-P65-AURKA相互作用并抑制P65磷酸化。在体内，GMB-475减少了M2巨噬细胞浸润并抑制了肿瘤生长。贝特类药物下调PLTP表达，降低P65磷酸化，并在原位和Myc驱动的HCC模型中与ICIs协同作用。这些发现强调了PLTP通过AURKA依赖性NF-kappaB激活作为M2巨噬细胞极化的关键介质。用抑制剂GMB-475或贝特类药物靶向PLTP可能提高ICIs疗效，为HCC提供了一种有前景的治疗策略。
